source.candidate: working tree; executable SHA256 identifies measured build

method: Alternate AB/BA process order; three harness warmups; medians are descriptive, not confidence intervals. Ratio is candidate/baseline; below 1 is faster.
scope: In-memory full compiler includes result destruction and provenance serialization, excludes CLI I/O and final squish. Discovery and prepared expansion phases run independently and are not additive. Artifacts compared by lengths and FNV-1a fingerprints, not a cryptographic equivalence proof.
